rows.method_detail: SU(2)-symmetric DMRG on tori and on AC, tZC and ZC cylinders (bulk energy from two cylinder lengths), energy per site against circumference extrapolated to infinite width (Fig. 3, dashed lines)
rows.method_as_published: DMRG; 'By extrapolating the energies in Fig. 3, we estimate -0.4378 and -0.4255 as the thermodynamic limit ground-state energies for J2 = 0.25 and 0.3'
rows.bound_type_reason: extrapolation to an infinite ansatz or to infinite size; not an upper bound (RULES.md 14.4)
rows.reference: Gong, Sheng, Motrunich & Fisher, Phase diagram of spin-1/2 J1-J2 Heisenberg model on honeycomb lattice, arXiv:1306.6067
